notes:
Compiled 2026-11-02. All caption_en strings were machine-checked as verbatim substrings of the saved page HTML (visible text or, where caption_type says so, the alt attribute); all image_url values returned HTTP 200/206 with an image/* content type on 2026-11-02; all waypoint ids exist in data/route.json. caption_type tells you how the caption relates to the photo. 'figure caption' and 'alt text' are per-image. 'text of the dated update entry' and 'adjacent page paragraph' mean the source has no per-image caption, so the quoted text is the entry or paragraph the image sits in or next to. Treat those as context, not as a strict caption. Visual observations in match_basis are labelled as such and are not source claims.

SOURCES USED
(1) westboundhorizons.com (Karl Bushby and Angela Maxwell's expedition site, Squarespace). Wayback CDX found only a few HTML pages; /situ (dated update entries 2021-2025) and /goliath-expedition (narrative) had expedition photos. Used snapshots 20251001034217 (/situ) and 20251007200315 (/goliath-expedition). The live domain now redirects to a parked or spam domain, but the images still load from images.squarespace-cdn.com, which these image_url values use. The CDN may serve WebP to browsers. No per-photo credits on this site.
(2) goliath.mail2web.com /Photos/LatestPhotos.asp, Wayback 20080530194113: an official gallery with alt-text captions. Large images load via Wayback im_ URLs, with the 2008-03-16 captures used.
(3) Explorersweb articles: photos credited 'Photo: Karl Bushby', 'Photo: Karl Bushby/Instagram' or 'Photo: Steppes to the West'.
(4) BBC News articles: only images whose 'Image source' is 'Karl Bushby' were kept.
(5) The Guardian, 2026-10-13: only 'Photograph: Courtesy of Karl Bushby' or Karl's TikTok were kept.
Several WestBound Horizons and gallery photos are also published by Explorersweb or the BBC with a Karl Bushby credit. These are listed in also_published, which strengthens the attribution.

CHECKED AND REJECTED
- goliath.mail2web.com gallery, October/November 2007 (images 60-73): the alt texts are repeated template strings ('October 6th', 'Oct. 15 - On route to Komsomolskiy', etc.) that visibly do not match the photos (e.g. an indoor group shot captioned 'On route'), so they were all skipped. The May/March 2007 blocks (39-49) have the same problem: for example, 'Downtown Anadyr' shows Karl addressing schoolchildren. Image 54 is captioned 'Oct. 27 - Road to Komsomolskiy' but sits under the 'September 2007' heading, so it was also skipped.
- blog.goliath.mail2web.com 2007-2008 posts (route.json sources 03:S34-S44): no photos in the archived posts, only banners.
- westboundhorizons.com images skipped because no source text describes them: Russia 2015 ('Russia+2015.jpg'); a frame showing Karl at a 'СОЛОВЬЕВСК' (Solovyevsk) road sign (vlcsnap-2017); the US protest-walk images (IMG_2185/2190/99.jpg, ambiguous placement); highway and snow images in the 1/5/2025 entry (Azerbaijan/Georgia/Turkey, no description); Uzbekistan desert images under entries whose text describes other events (e.g. 26/06/2023 photos taken before the border crossing they sit under); dust-storm, sunset, camel-silhouette and blister photos; maps, Washington Post screenshots and portraits.
- BBC images credited to BBC staff (Kevin Shoesmith, Crispin Rolfe), Getty, Reuters or Anadolu were excluded, which removed all Belgium/Mons and Lincolnshire photos. BBC Karl-credited images with no place in the caption or alt (snowy road in a red coat; desert road in a shemagh; cart in a sunhat) were also excluded.
- Guardian photos credited to Alicia Canter/The Guardian or Zach Guglin were excluded, as were Karl-credited ones from legs 01/02 outside this scope.
- Hull Daily Mail 2020 article (Wayback): photos have no credit or place, so none were used. Azertag was not used because its photos are agency photos, not credited to Karl.
- Explorersweb 2021 'Where in the World is Karl Bushby?' photos are credited to Karl but name no place, so they were skipped. The Steppes to the West photos in the 2019 Norjmaa interview were taken after Karl left, so they were skipped.
- Wikimedia Commons: Category:Karl_Bushby holds only a route map (File:Goliatexpeditionmap.jpg), with no photographs.
- karlbushby.world returned HTTP 429 to automated requests and has no Wayback captures, so it was not used. Karl's Instagram and TikTok accounts were not scraped.
- The Wayback CDX API intermittently returned 504 or 'Temporarily Offline'.

GAPS
No Karl- or team-credited, captioned photos were found for: Yakutia / Road of Bones / Amur / Zabaykalye (2015-2017), the Russia-Mongolia border, China/Xinjiang, Kazakhstan 2018-19, Turkmenistan, Georgia, Turkey east of Istanbul, the Balkans, Romania, Hungary, Austria, Germany, Belgium, France, or the walk through England after Dover. Several kept photos have waypoint=null because the source names no position. The 'region' field lets the map group them if wanted.
